title: Recipe 12: Approval, audit, and revocation
summary: An agent requests deletion of an invoice, a person approves or rejects it, and the audit trail records the request and decision. Revoked external calls fail closed.
summaryZh: Agent 请求删除发票，真人允许或拒绝，审计记录请求与决定。撤销后的外部调用会失败关闭。

files.label: App.vue
files.role: Approval UI, records, and audit view
files.roleZh: 审批界面、记录与审计视图

guide.title: The agent may request; the person decides
guide.titleZh: Agent 可以请求，真人作出决定
intro: Approval is absent from the agent tool list. The page renders a pending decision and sends the person's decision to the backend.
Request one deletion, reject it, then request again and approve it. Compare the invoice list with the audit events after each step.
introZh: 审批不在 Agent 的工具清单里。页面显示待决事项，并把真人的决定提交给后端。
先请求一次删除并拒绝，再请求一次并允许。每一步之后对照发票列表与审计事件。

steps.title: Expose request, not approval
steps.body: The tool creates a pending request. There is no approve tool for the model.
steps.bodyZh: 该工具只创建待决请求，模型没有批准工具。

steps.title: Show the decision to the person
steps.body: The page lists pending requests and sends approve or reject through its own handler.
steps.bodyZh: 页面列出待决请求，并通过自己的处理函数提交允许或拒绝。

steps.title: Keep audit public but bounded
steps.body: The state view exposes counts and the latest event type, not full parameters or approval secrets.
steps.bodyZh: 状态视图只暴露计数与最新事件类型，不暴露完整参数或审批秘密。

guide.note: Use the local account demo@example.com / pling-demo. Approval protects a teaching fixture; a production system still needs durable audit storage and its own authorization rules.
guide.noteZh: 使用本地账号 demo@example.com / pling-demo。示例审批保护的是教学夹具；生产系统仍需要持久审计与自身的授权规则。
